function.name: metrics_api_MetricsApi_get_portfolio_metrics_since
function.description: Retrieve historical metrics for the entire portfolio starting from a specified date. The date should be in the format of 'YYYYMMDD' (e.g., '20210101' for January 1st, 2021). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The start date to retrieve metrics from, formatted as 'YYYYMMDD'. For example, '20210101' represents January 1st, 2021.

function.name: repository_api_RepositoryApi_update_repository
function.description: Updates the specified details of an existing repository such as name, description, and privacy settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

repository_id.description: The unique identifier for the repository to be updated.

update_data.description: A collection of repository attributes that should be updated.

name.description: The new name for the repository.

description.description: A brief text description of the repository.

is_private.description: A flag indicating whether the repository is private or public.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_clone_project
function.description: Creates a duplicate of a specified project, including all its associated data and settings. The cloned project will have a new unique identifier but will inherit the properties and configurations of the original project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be cloned.

new_project_name.description: The name for the new cloned project.

include_data.description: Determines whether the data associated with the project should also be cloned.

message.content:
I don’t have a real‑time clock built into this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact current time.  
Just glance at the clock on your phone, computer, or wall to see the precise time. If you need help converting time zones or setting a reminder, let me know!
message.reasoning: User asks "What time is it?" We need to respond with current time. We don't have real-time capability, but we can approximate. We can say "I don't have real-time clock, but you can check your device." Probably best to give a generic answer.
